_justification.timestamp: block.timestamp is the intended clock for the UTC-day caps (HLPortal I6), the timelocks (I4, I5) and the heartbeats. A validator can move it by seconds, which cannot cross a 2-day timelock or a 90-day timeout; the day boundary is analysed as IR-07 in docs/audit/INTERNAL_SECURITY_REVIEW_2026-11-18.md.
_justification.low-level-calls: Native ETH is sent with call (HLPortal.withdraw, HLReceiver.rescue, HumanTimeLock.withdraw), every result is checked, and each function is nonReentrant. HumanityTimeLockVault._tryTransfer uses call on purpose so one blocked token cannot stop the sweep of the others.
_justification.solc-version: Hardhat and Foundry both compile with solc 0.8.24 (hardhat.config.js, foundry.toml); the ^0.8.20 pragmas only state the minimum.
_justification.pragma: Same as solc-version: two minimum pragmas (^0.8.20, ^0.8.24), one compiler.
_justification.calls-loop: HumanityTimeLockVault.executeDeadManSwitch and LedgerDeadmanSwitch.triggerInheritance loop over tokens by design; the vault caps the list at MAX_TOKENS and the switch's caller chooses its list.
